text:
maya: Heads up: putting together a small PR to pair the console tracing hook example with the cost/latency breakdown widget. Need an extra set of eyes for the example code and the dashboard JSON.
sam: on it. will spin up a branch. do we want the widget to show p50/p95 and token-cost per-route?
maya: Yes — p50/p95 + avg token cost. Ideally the example shows how to annotate traces with model and route so the dashboard groups correctly.
harper: Heads up: the current Python SDK snippet in docs uses `client.trace()` which we deprecated. We should switch to `client.start_trace()` or show the new context manager example.
alex: I also changed the metric name for `redwood.request.latency_ms` to `redwood.api.latency_ms` in infra. Need to update the queries in the dashboard JSON.
sam: noted. I'll update the dashboard panels. @maya do we want to keep the old metric as an alias for 3 months?
maya: Yes keep alias mapping for 90 days. Add a note in the migration guide section.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 - 'pairing: console tracing + cost widget' (maya -> sam).
link-checker: Link-check: broken link in examples/dashboard.json -> /old-metrics-name, flagged.
harper: I'll push a small SDK fix in the PR with the new context manager snippet. Snippet idea:

```python
from redwood import Client
with Client(api_key=...) as client:
    with client.start_trace('embed_request', tags={'model':'redwood-mini','route':'embed'}):
        resp = client.embeddings(input)
```

Is that ok for copy?
sam: :+1: looks good. Maybe show how to attach `token_cost` as a tag from returned usage object.
harper: sure. add after resp: `trace.add_metric('token_cost', resp.usage.token_cost)`
alex: Dashboard queries I'll update:
- latency: `avg(redwood.api.latency_ms) by (route)`
- cost: `sum(redwood.tokens.cost) by (route)`
Will also add a note on retention and alias mapping.
sam: I'll include migration snippet for Grafana / dashboard import id and a tiny script to rename metrics if folks run on-prem.
maya: Great. Can we add a small QA checklist in the PR: validate widget on prod-canary, run link-check, run `docs build --local`?
docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR#4823 (checks: link-check, md-lint, code-snippets).
link-checker: Link-check: flagged `/old-metrics-name` resolved in PR; re-run after merge.
sam: I'll request review from @harper and @alex and merge once green.
harper: reviewed, left one tiny nit about pluralization. LGTM after fix.
maya: thanks everyone — merging after CI. I'll follow up with a quick blurb in the release notes: Console: Tracing + Cost pairing + migration notes.
